dedupe_keys.name: establishments open to the public erp in seine et marne france

description: This layer lists establishments receiving the public (établissements recevant du public, ERP) in the Seine-et-Marne department east of Paris, published by the departmental territories directorate from the list kept by the departmental fire and rescue service (SDIS 77) and georeferenced. In French law an ERP is any public or private place that admits people other than staff, so the layer covers cinemas, theatres, shops from small stores to hypermarkets, libraries, schools, universities, hotels, restaurants, hospitals, stations, places of worship and temporary structures such as marquees; it includes ERP of categories 1 to 4 and category 5 establishments subject to periodic inspection, and some entries are described without coordinates. Coverage: Seine-et-Marne (77). Access: free Atom download of MapInfo tables and WMS and WFS services through the geo-ide platform, listed on data.gouv.fr (created 2014, resources updated November 2024). Licence: Licence Ouverte 2.0. Caveats: not all establishments are georeferenced, and attributes follow fire safety categories, not building characteristics. Simulation uses: exposure of crowded buildings to floods and other hazards, and evacuation and fire service planning. Related records: the Grand Paris Sud Est Avenir ERP list and the USGS National Structures Dataset.
